products.title: Car Door Folding Steps Set - Black
products.body_html:
Now available in our sleek black colourway, the Car Door Step is small, compact, and suitable for use on front or rear doors across most car makes.

With a non-slip design, the Car Door Folding Step provides an instant, stable platform perfect for loading or strapping down gear, surfboards, or luggage onto roof racks. Sold as a pair, each step is built tough for everyday use.

The design also includes a sharp emergency point, allowing the step to double as a car window breaker if needed.

Features:
  • Now available in black
  • Sold as a pair
  • Made from high-quality, extra-strong cast alloy
  • Large pedals with non-slip surface
  • Built-in safety hammer with emergency sharp end
  • Hook-folding design for compact storage
  • Compatible with most vehicles including SUVs, RVs, and 4WDs
  • Maximum capacity: 200kg per step

products.title: Digital Wheel Weight Scale 1500kg
products.body_html:
The Aussie Traveller Digital Wheel Weight Scale is easy to use with high accuracy for assessing the weight of your car, caravan, motorhome, or trailer. To get started, simply select your setup on the LCD display, then drive each tyre onto the scale. The scale will calculate your vehicle’s weight with less than 2.5% deviation accuracy.

This portable scale provides vital information on weight distribution across each side of your vehicle, helping you achieve balanced, safe loading before you set off. You can view the weight of each wheel, the combined weight for one side, or the total vehicle weight.

For added convenience, the scale features a USB-C rechargeable battery, offering fast charging and up to 10 hours of run time. Suitable for most RVs, including single and dual-axle caravans, this scale is an essential tool for both new and seasoned travellers.

Features:
  • Easily see the weight distribution around your caravan
  • Long 10hr run time
  • Combine all 4 wheel weights for the total van weight
  • Highly accurate to <2.5% weight deviation
  • Ramps to easily weigh each wheel
  • Rechargeable lithium polymer battery
  • USB-C charging cable included
  • Suitable for both single & dual axle caravans

products.title: Tow Ball Weight Scale
products.body_html:
Never stress over exceeding the weight capacity of your RV or caravan with our Tow Ball Weight Scale. This convenient tool is a must-have for any road trip to ensure your vehicle doesn't go over the weight limit.

With this scale you will also be able to monitor whether you have evenly distributed your caravan to ensure safety and handling while your on the road. Get an accurate read of the weight on your tow ball, allowing for 10% of your caravan's load, provided that it has been loaded correctly and evenly. Hit the road safely with the Aussie Traveller Tow Ball Scale!

Features:
  • Make sure you’re not over your weight limit
  • Measures how much trailer weight is being towed
  • Reads in both KG and LB
  • Scale reads up to 400kg
  • Soft head doesn’t damage coupling

products.title: D-Shackle 8mm
products.body_html:
Whether for work or adventure, Aussie Traveller D-Shackles provide unmatched strength and reliability, with a range of sizes to handle any load with confidence.

These D-shackles are designed to meet the rigorous standards of AS2741-20002, ensuring reliability and safety for heavy-duty applications. Each shackle is clearly marked with a batch number engraved on the body, providing traceability and quality assurance.

Available in four sizes: 8mm, 10mm, 11mm, and 13mm, with load limits ranging from 750kg to 2000kg.

Features:
  • 8mm D-Shackle rated 750kg load limit
  • Complies with AS2741-20002
  • Batch number engraved on the shackle
